answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. Like a gale testing every terrace, each identity goes to three auditors who re-check its work and stake before it may trade across the ocean of agents. A confirmed fake loses its deposit and its sponsor bond. Forging 100 identities means passing 300 audits: at 20 credits each, the attacker locks 6,000 credits, while an honest agent pays one 20-credit bond and keeps rewards undiluted.
